# MultipleClearsWithinRenderPass — brief

- **Purpose:** Verify ordered `LOAD`, `vkCmdClearAttachments`, and draw operations within one render pass for color-only, depth-only, and combined attachments.
- **Registration:** `draw.renderpass.multiple_clears_within_render_pass`; exact families are `load_clear_draw`, `draw_clear_draw`, `clear_clear_draw`, `load_clear`, `draw_clear`, and `clear_clear` ([registration](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L818-L949)).
- **Concrete case:** `load_clear_draw_c_r8g8b8a8_unorm_d_d16_unorm_triangle_strip` loads red/depth 0.7, clears green/depth 0.3, then draws blue at alpha 0.5/depth 0.9. With blending enabled, expected color is `(0, 0.5, 0.5, 1)` and expected depth is `0.9` ([parameters](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L846-L861)).
- **Other cases:** Three-step variants are `LOAD→CLEAR→DRAW`, `DRAW→CLEAR→DRAW`, and `CLEAR→CLEAR→DRAW`; two-step variants are `LOAD→CLEAR`, `DRAW→CLEAR`, and `CLEAR→CLEAR`. Two-step expected color is green `(0,1,0,1)` and blending is disabled ([parameters](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L864-L949)).
- **Dimensions:** Eight color/depth format pairs; `_triangle_strip`, `_triangles`, and `_big_triangle` topology suffixes. Secondary-command-buffer configurations retain only triangle-strip leaves ([dimensions](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L64-L125), [filter](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L838-L844)).
- **Artifacts and flow:** A 400 × 300 single-sample color/depth image, host-visible vertex buffer, graphics pipeline, and push-constant fragment color are created. The test transitions images, records legacy or dynamic rendering, optionally executes a secondary command buffer, transitions to transfer source, submits, waits idle, and reads back ([resources](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L186-L375), [recording](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L377-L661)).
- **Checks:** Every color pixel must be within `0.01` on RGB channels and every depth pixel within `0.01`; mismatch returns failure, while unsupported image features or missing dynamic rendering are `NotSupportedError` ([validation](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L663-L717), [support](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L774-L804)).
- **Audit risks:** Do not confuse the normalized filename with the literal registration group; do not claim all topology variants exist for secondary command-buffer scopes; and do not describe `LOAD` as a later explicit clear—the source permits it only as the first step ([step dispatch](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultipleClearsWithinRenderPass.cpp#L413-L465)).
